summary: E2E testing completed for re-architected IA (hub-and-tab) + Order Makloon integration. All 9 user stories (US-1 to US-9) verified successfully. No regressions detected.
passed_tests: US-1: Admin login successful, sidebar hub-and-tab structure renders correctly with all groups (Penjualan, Pembelian, Gudang, RFID & Traceability, Keuangan, SDM) expandable
US-2: Mode Pengadaan dropdown in 'Buat PO' displays 3 options correctly: 'Beli Finished Goods' (PO standar), 'Raw Material & Proses' (makloon buy_process), 'Proses Saja' (makloon process_only)
US-3: Order Makloon correctly implemented as TAB within 'Pesanan Pembelian (PO)' hub (not standalone menu). Tab bar shows: 'Pesanan Pembelian (PO)', 'Blanket / Kontrak', 'Order Makloon'
US-4: Master Pembelian hub renders with 3 tabs: 'Pemasok (Supplier)', 'Mitra Makloon', 'Resep Proses'. All tabs render content without errors
US-5: Produk & Harga hub renders with 6 tabs: 'Produk (Master)', 'Template & Varian', 'Kategori', 'Pustaka Warna', 'Satuan (UOM)', 'Pricelist per-PT'. All tabs present and functional
US-6: Gudang (Master) renders CRUD interface with 3 warehouses: Gudang Jakarta Utara (WH-JKT), Gudang Bandung Kopo (WH-BDG), Gudang Surabaya Rungkut (WH-SBY)
US-7: Settings hub correctly trimmed to 2 tabs: 'Master Data & Audit', 'Approval Rules'. Product/Category/UOM/Warehouse tabs successfully relocated to domain-specific hubs

US-8: Core regression tests passed - Dashboard (Control Tower) renders with KPIs, POS/Sales Portal renders product catalog, Sales Orders (Pesanan & Retur) renders with tab bar and order list. No red screen or console errors
US-9: Command Palette (Ctrl+K) opens correctly with role-aware menu search functionality
